## Problem and motivation
Describe the user-visible problem this change solves.

## Implementation
Summarize the actual source changes and design choices.

## How to test
Provide reproducible commands and observed results.

## Review checklist
- [ ] Scope is focused and code changes are substantive
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior
- [ ] No credentials, API keys, or .env files added
- [ ] Documentation updated where appropriate
- [ ] Reviewer has inspected the diff
